changelog: The start-up screen can no longer last forever: a kernel that cannot be started is now handled like one that crashed (restart, automatic restore, recovery screen), the npm repair has a time limit, packages missing right after an update that never booted restore the previous version instead of running npm, and after three minutes without a kernel the recovery screen appears. Includes the 2.1.0-beta.3 fixes: no restart offer in the middle of an update, a calm start-up screen, no empty setup sections, and the Updater tells you when a channel is older.
